jobs.title: Lead, Office of Software Assurance
jobs.desc: Role Summary Â The Office of Software Assurance (OSA) Lead is the senior individual contributor who establishes and leads the Office of Software Assurance, a new shift-left software quality function inside the Agile Office, through technical expertise and influence rather than line management. The OSA embeds right-sized, risk-based assurance into a 1,000+ person Engineering organization, so that compliance evidence is produced as a natural, tool-native output of how teams build, not assembled after the fact. Â You will own day-to-day software quality execution across three lifecycle domains (SDLC, Computer Software Assurance, and Infrastructure Qualification). Nateraâs Software Quality Assurance department keeps independent oversight, approval authority, and the front-line role in audits and inspections. Your focus is faster, simpler, and compliant delivery, and you do it in a way you can defend to an auditor. The ideal candidate is a software engineer first, someone who understands code, CI/CD, and engineering tooling, and who has worked close enough to regulated environments to apply quality and regulatory expectations without becoming a bottleneck. Â What You Will Do Â Stand up the OSA and execute its charter in phases: Launch (engineering-tool assurance), Extend (product-software assurance planning and evidence-readiness review), and Mature (largely automated, tool-native release-readiness evidence, with SQA operating by exception). Own the OSA Charter and the OSA Responsibility Governance Matrix, and keep them current with SQA concurrence. Review annually or sooner as responsibilities phase in. Provide technical direction, coaching, and quality review for the OSA assurance resources, and contribute to their hiring and development plans in partnership with the Head of Agile Office. Coordinate, coach, and quality-check the engineers assigned the SQE capability within engineering teams. Define baselines and targets with the Sponsor and report on OSA success metrics: assurance turnaround and cycle time versus the legacy CSV path, deliverables per release versus the 8â10-per-release baseline, intake quality, SQA relief, inspection readiness, and capability milestones. Deliver right-sized assurance Oversee AL1âAL2 assurance planning and participate in AL3âAL4 assurance under the CSA SOP. This covers the path from CSA Intake through Software Assurance Plan, execution, report and closeout, and Service Catalog registration. Recommend the Assurance Level and assurance approach at CSA Intake. Select assurance activities and acceptance criteria from the Assurance Method Menu within an assigned level. Support SQA's level-confirmation walkthroughs. Drive a documented-critical-thinking culture. Teams should be able to explain their risk-based rationale to an auditor and apply the least-burdensome approach. Provide oversight, guidance, and continued standardization under the SDLC SOP and Infrastructure Qualification. Over time, provide product-software risk-classification input, assurance and verification planning, evidence-readiness review, and periodic review by Assurance Level. Â Govern engineering tools and change Own and execute the Engineering Tool Governance Work Instruction, from tool admission through retirement. Own and manage the Engineering Service Catalog, including registration of tools that hold regulated records. Oversee tool qualification. Provide fast-path change oversight and impact disposition on engineering tickets under the Software Change Work Instruction. Route device-software changes to SQA. Consult with Agile Office tooling administration on the assurance impact of tooling decisions. Â Partner with Software Quality Assurance (SQA) and the business Operate the inspection-readiness model: the OSA executes and supplies the technical narrative and tool-native evidence, while SQA approves determinations, plans, and closeouts and leads in audits and inspections. Maintain defined escalation triggers to SQA. Escalate unresolved scope or risk questions to the Sponsor and SQA leadership. Work with Product Managers and Lab Directors, who hold charter-level accountability for intended use and business need, so intended use is clearly communicated at intake and confirmed at delivery. Collaborate with the Security Team on lifecycle integration points (cybersecurity methodology stays with Security) and with Regulatory/QA on design-control boundaries. Â Build capability and automate Lead delivery of the SQE Upskilling Competency Development Plan across four tiers: regulatory and standards literacy, risk-based assurance and critical thinking, modern V V and tool-native evidence practices, and quality judgment. Provide compliant-SDLC coaching, process-feedback management, and training content. Source external training through bodies such as AAMI, ISPE, RAPS, and ASQ. Champion automation: embed evidence capture in the tools of record (for example, source control, ticketing, CI/CD, and test management), so evidence is cited by reference rather than assembled by hand. Â Required Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience). 8+ years of software engineering experience, with hands-on development, test automation, DevOps, or engineering productivity work. You can read code and review pipelines, and you earn credibility with engineers. 4+ years working in or closely alongside a regulated environment, such as medical device, diagnostics, clinical laboratory, pharma or biotech, or another environment under design controls and a quality management system. Working knowledge of risk-based software assurance and validation concepts, such as FDA Computer Software Assurance (CSA) guidance, computer system validation, or software verification and validation. Practical familiarity with several of: IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, 21 CFR Part 820 / QMSR, 21 CFR Part 11, IEC 81001-5-1, AAMI TIR45. 3+ years of technical leadership experience, such as leading cross-functional programs through influence and mentoring engineers, and experience building or scaling a process or function. People management experience is a plus but not required. Demonstrated ability to partner with an independent quality function and to hold a clear line between execution and independent oversight. Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain a risk rationale to engineers, executives, and auditors. Â Preferred Direct experience supporting or hosting FDA, notified-body, CAP, CLIA, or ISO audits and inspections. Experience with AI, agile at scale, engineering tool governance, or tool qualification. Experience with GAMP 5, SaaS or cloud-tool qualification, or infrastructure qualification for software and cloud platforms. Experience automating compliance evidence in tools such as Jira and Jama, source control, CI/CD, and test management platforms. Experience in clinical diagnostics, genomics, or lab informatics software. Certifications such as ASQ CSQE, CQA, or RAPS RAC. Experience designing competency or upskilling programs for engineers. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations. jobs.title: Senior iOS Engineer
jobs.desc: About Voodoo Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz. Team The Engineering Data team builds innovative tech products and platforms to support the impressive growth of their gaming and consumer apps which allow Voodoo to stay at the forefront of the mobile industry. Helix is our flagship Ad-Network team of around 60 top-tier engineers and data scientists spanning backend, mobile SDKs, data engineering, infrastructure, and AI. Helix has evolved beyond powering Voodoo's own gaming portfolio—our technology is now directly integrated into games from external, third-party publishers worldwide. Operating across millions of third-party devices in real-time bidding environments creates unique technical challenges around SDK performance, ultra-low latency, and intelligent automation. Within Helix, you’ll join the AdExperience squad—a focused team of Senior Product Managers, QA/Release Engineers, and five exceptional Senior Engineers specialized in backend and mobile SDK development. Together, you will push the boundaries of iOS SDK architecture and champion modern, agentic AI workflows to set new industry standards. Role We’re looking for a visionary and talented Senior iOS Engineer to join our dynamic, passionate, and committed to excellence team at the forefront of advertising technology! As a Senior iOS Engineer, you will drive the development of cutting-edge SDKs, influencing the experience of millions of users across diverse devices. A pivotal member of our engineering team, you will help shape the direction of our iOS technical efforts while serving as a high-impact, hands-on individual contributor. Technical Vision Code Standards: Guide the technical direction for our iOS projects. Drive innovation, establish architectural best practices, and ensure the highest standards of code craftsmanship across our codebase. AI Usage Agentic Workflows: Raise the bar in AI adoption across the team—actively integrating agentic workflows, LLMs, and AI-driven automation tools to solve complex challenges and elevate developer productivity. Code Excellence: Craft robust, maintainable, and high-performance code that sets industry benchmarks as a senior hands-on individual contributor. Collaborative Code Reviews: Actively participate in thorough code reviews, fostering a culture of continuous technical improvement and knowledge sharing within the engineering team. Architectural Decisions: Make critical decisions regarding the architecture and technical stack of our iOS SDKs and applications to ensure long-term stability and scalability. Quality Assurance: Guarantee the enduring quality and reliability of our iOS projects through rigorous testing, performance profiling, and continuous integration practices. Profile 6/7+ years of experience in mobile software development. 5 years minimum in Swift. Strong proficiency and proactive mindset towards leveraging AI technologies (e.g., agentic AI, LLMs, AI coding assistants) to enhance software development efficiency and code quality. Excellent problem-solving, critical thinking, and communication skills. Demonstrated ability to make critical technical decisions independently. Extensive experience in writing robust, maintainable, and high-performance Swift code. Writing efficient unit tests, integration tests, and UI tests. In-depth knowledge of iOS development tools, frameworks (SwiftUI, Combine, and CoreData), and best practices (MVVM, Protocols, Delegates). Excellent level of spoken English. Nice to have Previous experience in the AdTech industry or in mobile ads integration. Experience with SDK development and a deep understanding of the challenges and opportunities in this space. Experience in Objective-C, Kotlin, Node. Practical experience setting up or customizing AI developer agents and automated AI workflows. Experience in optimizing App performance, reducing memory footprint, and decreasing package size. Experience in deploying iOS frameworks on CocoaPods. Experience in deploying iOS applications with CircleCI and Fastlane. Working knowledge of remote APIs, concurrency, layouts, transitions, animations. jobs.desc: Our story Every year, millions struggle with tax filing or miss out on tax refunds. We’re fixing that.
